description: We are building HydroWatch Global (AquaSentinel), a satellite platform monitoring drought and water contraction in hydroelectric infrastructure. Using NASA data (Landsat, GPM, SMAP, SWOT, MODIS) for risk indexing, we provide early warnings for grids like the Zambezi Basin. Join us to build an interactive mapping tool. We seek teammates skilled in web development, Python/Google Earth Engine geospatial analysis, machine learning, or hydrology.
